description: Searches online stores' product catalogs for shopping requests such as product types, brands, budgets and gift ideas. Each result describes a selected variant, with its Nobi variant ID (id and variantId), parent productId, merchantId, source IDs, name, store, catalog price and currency, stock status, image and link. People buy from the store. When linkLabel is set, such as "We may earn a commission", show it beside that product's link.

limit.description: How many products to return, from 1 to 20. The default is 10.

query.description: What the user is looking for, in plain words, with the details that matter to them, such as "waterproof hiking boots" or "linen dress for a summer wedding under $150".

name: search_products

id.description: Legacy alias for the selected Nobi variantId; null for parent details. productId identifies the parent.

title: Search products across independent stores
